title: Knowledge grounding: which data can a Copilot Studio agent answer from?
summary: Hold: the Dataverse search automation only reads the setting instead of changing it. The billing question also leaves a documented distinction unresolved: Microsoft Copilot harness agents are billed differently from standard-harness agents. The knowledge-source paths, published rates and authentication prerequisites are otherwise supported.

claims.where: Risks and limits: Turning it off withholds answers

claims.quote: When you turn off this setting, the agent blocks any response generated in a turn where it didn't use a knowledge source or tool.

claims.where: Risks and limits: Turning it off withholds answers

claims.where: Risks and limits: Turning it off withholds answers
claims.claim: With the setting off, a knowledge-source answer requires an in-text citation.
claims.quote: When you turn off Allow ungrounded responses, the agent returns an answer from a knowledge source only when the answer includes an in-text citation to that source.

claims.where: Risks and limits: Turning it off withholds answers
claims.claim: A correct answer without a citation can be withheld.
claims.quote: Occasionally, the model generates a correct answer from a knowledge source but doesn't include a citation for it. When that happens, the agent withholds the answer and responds as though it didn't find any information.

claims.claim: Disallowing Documents uploads blocks local uploads but SharePoint and OneDrive require their separate restriction.

claims.where: Risks and limits: Uploaded files skip per-user checks

claims.quote: The upload files method allows anyone with permission to the agent to access the file. With SharePoint, the user's credentials are verified to ensure they have permission to access the file before providing responses.
